name: Lashed Ram Golem

Traits.name: Thunder Absorption
Traits.text: Whenever the ram golem is subjected to Thunder damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Thunder damage dealt.

Traits.name: Magic Resistance
Traits.text: The ram golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The ram golem makes two Ram attacks.

Actions.name: Ram
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) Thunder damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Thunderclap Retort
Bonus Actions.text: One creature within 5 feet that hit the ram golem with an attack roll since the end of the ram golem's last turn takes 11 (2d10) Thunder damage.
Bonus Actions.clause: a siege-engine golem of lashed timber

lore: A field-expedient siege golem lashed from felled trunks, scrap iron, and the bones of its fallen builders, it knows only one direction: through.

generation.userConcept: a siege-engine golem of lashed timber that shoulders through walls

clauses.text: a siege-engine golem of lashed timber

generation.cite: composition after Flesh Golem (CR 5) — the made thing that cannot be unmade

immunities: Poison, Thunder; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
